new_points.title: Alexander Zverev holds his nerve against Karen Khachanov to reach US Open final
new_points.content: Zverev wins 6-3, 7-6 (7), 7-6 (6)German reaches third straight grand slam finalAbout 107 minutes into men’s semi-final day on Arthur Ashe Stadium, there was finally a touch of tension radiating from the court. After falling down a set and break, his semi-final meeting with his old rival Alexander Zverev swiftly turning into a beating, Karen Khachanov fought hard to force a second-set tie-break. Deep in that tension-filled tie-break, down 5-6 on his serve, Khachanov saved Zverev’s first set point with a bold forehand winner, and then at 6-7 he punctuated a screaming backhand passing shot winner with an imperious roar of his own.There was a time when Zverev might have faltered under such pressure, but he has won too many big matches this year to allow such a small surge from a lower-ranked opponent to scare him. Zverev composed himself and he quickly regained control, navigating a second tense tie-break in similar fashion as he moved to within one match of winning a second career grand slam title in his last three major appearances by defeating Khachanov 6-3, 7-6 (7), 7-6 (6). Continue reading...

new_points.title: 66-million-year-old feather in dinosaur poop may reveal why birds survived the asteroid
new_points.content: A feather discovered inside 66-million-year-old fossilized dinosaur poop may help explain why modern birds survived the asteroid catastrophe. The extinct bird it came from had more primitive insulating feathers, suggesting superior plumage may have helped the ancestors of living birds endure the deadly impact winter.

new_points.title: Jon Ledecky Reflects on Sept. 11 and NYC Sports Scene
new_points.content: Jon Ledecky, NHL team New York Islanders co-owner, sat down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick to remember the events on Sept. 11, the power of sports and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Former NY Fed President on Remembering 9/11
new_points.content: William Dudley discussed his experience on a diverted flight during the FAA ground stop after the 9/11 attacks. Dudley said the plane was unable to land in the U.S. and was sent to Saint John’s, Newfoundland, where passengers were kept for six days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: KBW CEO on Re-Building Manhattan After 9/11

new_points.title: Former NYC Deputy Mayor on Remembering 9/11
new_points.content: Former NYC Deputy Mayor Edward Skyler reflects on the aftermath of 9/11, saying it was extremely difficult to make decisions in the wake of the tragedy. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: SL Green CFO on Lower Manhattan's Rebound After 9/11

He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

new_points.title: Finding Stability in Investing: Masters in Business with Seth Bernstein
